visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in his late 20s or early 30s with long wavy black hair, wearing a dark grey long-sleeve shirt with "DIGIMON" branding and a brown cap. He stands in an indoor exhibition space, looking down at a pink cowboy hat mounted on a blue backdrop that mimics a sky with white clouds. He uses a handheld device to interact with the display. The lighting is dominated by purple and blue neon hues, creating a cool-toned atmosphere. (2) The scene shifts to a top-down view of various merchandise items spread across a colorful table cover featuring anime character art. There are circular character badges, stickers, and boxes containing themed fragrance or oil bottles. The man's hands are visible as he moves past the items. The background shows acrylic stands and plush toys in glass display cases. (3) A chronological history of the franchise is shown on a large white wall panel titled "數碼寶貝 25週年歷史." It features key dates from 1994 to 1999 with corresponding poster art and screenshots. The camera pans across the wall, showing the progression of movie and television broadcasts. (4) The man is seen holding a white stamp card, moving through the exhibition. He looks at character design sheets depicting "Chosen Children" like Tai and Matt, as well as their Digimon partners. He points his finger at a character's face on the wall. The camera uses handheld motion, creating a dynamic first-person perspective of the tour. (5) A dedicated wall display features several rows of transparent acrylic cases, each housing a replica of the "Digivice" in different colors such as orange, purple, blue, and yellow. The man walks past a series of phone booth replicas and enters a new area separated by black curtains. (6) In a more interactive segment, the man stands behind a large cardboard cutout of a brown garbage can, mimicking a famous scene from the show. He makes various hand gestures and expressions. The background is a dark wall with small floating heart graphics. (7) The final sequence shows high-quality prints of emotional ending scenes from the anime, including a train station departure and a vast desert landscape. Traditional Chinese subtitles are printed alongside the artwork. The man eventually waves his hand over several limited-edition collectible cards featuring character portraits.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: DIGIMON ADVENTURE. [Slogan]: 10.25 SAT - 11.24 SUN. (2) [Subtitle]: 歡迎回來，被選召的孩子們。 (3) [Subtitle]: 數碼寶貝 25週年歷史. (4) [Subtitle]: 1999年3月6日. 劇場版《數碼寶貝》上映. (5) [Subtitle]: 1999年3月7日. 電視動畫《數碼寶貝大冒險》首播. (6) [Subtitle]: 太一，我一直在這裡等。我是滾球獸！ (7) [Subtitle]: 神聖計劃. (8) [Subtitle]: 又進化了...聽說是暴龍獸！？ (9) [Subtitle]: 聲音很好聽呢！ (10) [Logo]: Photo Spot. [Slogan]: 重現那一幕！化身成角色，一起來拍吧！ (11) [Subtitle]: 年糕獸，謝謝你。 (12) [Subtitle]: 迪路獸是嘉兒的數碼寶貝啊！ (13) [Subtitle]: 我一直一直在尋找著，嘉兒！ (14) [Subtitle]: 當我發現的時候，我也做了和媽媽一樣的事，於是我明白了，那就是媽媽的愛。 (15) [Subtitle]: 我也喜歡美美呀！ (16) [Subtitle]: 你們兩個都一直... (17) [Subtitle]: 巫師獸！謝謝你... (18) [Subtitle]: 能遇見你真是太好了...謝謝你... (19) [Subtitle]: 我跟你的決鬥要延後到那時候了。 (20) [Subtitle]: 吸血魔獸你阻礙了我們最後更要侵略世界！ (21) [Subtitle]: 為什麼只有我不能進化啊？ (22) [Subtitle]: 重臨數碼世界 對戰黑暗四天王. (23) [Logo]: DARK MASTERS. (24) [Logo]: DIGIMON ADVENTURE LAST EVOLUTION. (25) [Subtitle]: 離別...然後前往未來. (26) [Subtitle]: 八位孩子們的暑假冒險結束了。 (27) [Subtitle]: 只要我們沒有忘記數碼寶貝，當我們心有所願的時候，他們就會在我們的心中。不，說不定...

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with the high-energy J-Pop intro of "Butter-Fly." A male vocalist's sharp, driving tenor voice dominates the track. Underneath, a rhythmic rock drum kit and distorted electric guitar create a bright, nostalgic sonic texture. Distant, muffled murmurs of an indoor crowd are barely audible. (2) A synthetic whoosh sound effect marks a visual transition. The music enters the verse with a walking bassline and crisp hi-hat hits. The singer's delivery is passionate, with clear Japanese articulation and a high melodic contour. Low-level ambient floor noise from the exhibition hall is present. (3) A sharp 'thud' or impact SFX triggers as the camera moves between displays. The background music maintains its energetic 165 BPM tempo. The harmonic structure is firmly in a major mode, evoking feelings of excitement and adventure. No foreground speech from the creator is detected. (4) As the video pans over concept art, the BGM's spectral brightness increases, emphasizing high-frequency synthesizers. Occasional shuffling and footsteps from nearby visitors are captured as incidental noises. The Signal-to-Noise Ratio remains very high, favoring the studio-produced musical track over environmental sound. (5) The final phase features a rhythmic buildup in the music, characterized by rapid drum fills and swelling guitar chords. The vocalist reaches the peak of his arousal during the chorus. The audio concludes with a smooth cross-fade into a softer melodic outro, maintaining high tonal purity throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and showcase the immersive experience of the Digimon Adventure 25th Anniversary Exhibition. The video captures the nostalgia of the franchise through close-ups of merchandise, historical timelines, and interactive photo spots, all synchronized to the original theme song to appeal to long-time fans.
